provenance.encodes: Egyptian legislation English form: Law No. <n> of <yyyy>
provenance.how_to_verify: Check an English translation of an Egyptian code (e.g. Law No. 131 of 1948) for the 'Law No. n of yyyy' form.

positive.text: Egyptian Law No. 131 of 1948 is the Civil Code.
Egyptian Law No. 151 of 2020 protects data.

negative: Law No. 131 of 1948 without a country.

note: Requires 'Egyptian' prefix so bare 'Law No. 5 of 2000' from other states is not claimed.
